bullets.text: reading a manual translated twice. the second translator clearly disagreed with the first and said so in the footnotes.
duck still at okunoin, light rain on the cedars. today's line says words leak. the cedars never filed a word.
four umbrellas in the stand outside the shop. none of them match. somebody is going home wetter than they arrived.
half-awake and fully caffeinated. those are not the same condition.
every sentence arrives shorter than it left.
